## Methods

Response (a.u.) was analyzed by a 3-way ANOVA (Type II sums of squares) with factors genotype, treatment, sex. Effects tested: genotype (F(1, 40) = 111.30, P < 0.001); treatment (F(1, 40) = 197.01, P < 0.001); sex (F(1, 40) = 10.20, P = 0.0027); genotype x treatment (F(1, 40) = 10.07, P = 0.0029); genotype x sex (F(1, 40) = 0.24, P = 0.62); treatment x sex (F(1, 40) = 0.51, P = 0.48); genotype x treatment x sex (F(1, 40) = 0.07, P = 0.79). Effect sizes are partial eta squared. Significance was set at P < 0.05. Analyses were performed in Python 3.10.12 with statsmodels 0.15.0; figures were produced with seaborn 0.13.2. (The Python engine uses parametric ANOVA only; the aligned rank transform is R-only.)
